implementation_checkpoint: 2026-11-09 round1: consumer shells, raw-reader software/negative checks, deterministic three-region decisions, source-role/quality protocols and finite capacity plan; physical endpoint qualification and admitted physical runner still pending
supersedes: model_fast_prototype_v1.json revision3 speed-first primary policy; frozen old evidence retains its identity
confirmation: 2026-11-09 user: operator-only input-to-output delay and combinational area conditioned on features/load/T; three measured operator-data-slack regions with three points each as a goal and at most thirteen targets including locators; owner-specific S and frozen-base G residuals; planning only this round
latency_policy: MAC32 L=2 II=1; no automatic increase to hide timing infeasibility

request.target_period_ps: required finite positive user input; no implicit target inherited from old experiments

selection.timing_context: all stage node, S and G queries share the user target and compatible declared ABC/SDC/IO conditions
selection.tie_breaking: predicted complete stage delay then shared register bits then stable candidate/placement order; exact numerical comparison rules frozen before evaluation

fallback.confirmation: 2026-11-09 user: emit target_unmet RTL minimizing predicted timing violation then area when no qualified evaluated candidate meets target
fallback.trigger: no complete-model-covered evaluated schedule satisfies the original target under fixed L/II
fallback.eligible_candidates: only fully covered and semantically/legal evaluated schedules
fallback.violation_ps: max over complete constrained paths of max(0, -predicted_slack_ps), same boundaries/margins as feasibility check
fallback.no_covered_candidate: report cost_uncovered or bounded_search limitation; no fabricated model-backed fallback
fallback.scope: best among qualified evaluated schedules only; do not claim global infeasibility or global optimality
fallback.later_measured_timing_status: reported separately at original target; no reselection

operator_model.target: paired measured operator input-to-output maximum delay and operator combinational area conditioned on target
operator_model.ABC_SDC_relation: ABC=SDC; only this joint relation is claimed; independent effects are not identified
operator_model.input_slew_and_load: frozen or calculable before prediction; no measured current-design feature
operator_model.primary_clock_dependence: piecewise nonlinear; compare bounded segmented regression and shallow tree candidates with simple baselines
operator_model.shape_hypothesis: tight/loose plateaus and a transition region are hypotheses; discontinuities and local regressions retained; continuity or monotonicity not imposed without validation
operator_model.width_policy: prefer shared across-width model; allow registered width-group or operand-width-pair functions if train/validation justifies them; retain target/load/shape dependence and report lost across-width coverage
operator_model.breakpoints_and_grouping: learned on train and selected with validation under preregistered limits, frozen before new independent test
operator_model.training_rows: all complete eligible train/validation-role target points, including locator and nonmonotonic points; locked_test never enters fitting
operator_model.test_grouping: all clocks, stages and replicas of one source stay in one role; independent source/context validation of target interpolation and of each claimed width domain

output_labels.operator_delay_ps: independent maximum within the declared operator input-to-output boundary; not historical launch-Q to capture-D or a segment on one witness
output_labels.comb_area_um2: operator-owned combinational cell area of the same implementation at the same target
output_labels.data_setup_slack_ps: measured minimum signed setup slack on declared data paths through the operator; offline region selection and joint verification only

sampling.region_slack_definition: minimum required-arrival minus actual-arrival over complete declared functional data paths through the operator; includes real consumer/capture context; positive slack not clipped
sampling.confirmed_parameters: data-path scope, strict outside-ten-percent regions, nine reference ratios, three-per-region goal, thirteen total attempts including locators, retain all eligible role-appropriate labels
sampling.coverage_shortfall: report measured counts, T/r span, reference deviations, missing regions and bounded stopping reason; no infinite points, no claim of absent region or unvalidated cross-region support
sampling.historical_scan_implemented_policy: model_fast_scan_v2.json; historical ten-point protocol only, not the current execution policy
sampling.runner_note: pure engine validated; actual EDA orchestration, mapped semantic endpoint coverage and freeze-gated test execution are not admitted by this software milestone
sampling.near_fast_stability_role: optional evidence-based auxiliary summary; not a conditional-label gate and not mandatory extra runs beyond thirteen
sampling.near_fast_summary_role: auxiliary same-implementation summary, not the sole conditional labels
sampling.conditional_point_eligibility: complete source/stage/ownership and independent operator endpoint maximum; negative setup and nonmonotonic labels retained; test role stays test; failed/incomplete points have no invented zero label

S_reuse: unchanged coefficients first; validate three actual owners, protocol and current ABC=SDC joint target domain; old exact-clock qualification does not transfer automatically
G: frozen-base stage residual validation with zero correction as a formal candidate; operator and S versions, target, path scope and ownership bound before fit/test
I: optional replacement price, never additive on owned nodes

historical_speed_first.scope: old prototype selection only; not the current timing allowance

S_model.area_labels: mutually exclusive owner-specific functional state/control area from independent state sources; no total-stage label
S_model.features: precomputable variable data bits, words/signals, valid/enable/reset-one bits and domains, widths, bank geometry, shared chains/lifetimes, owner and actual update protocol; new dimensions require a successor schema
S_model.boundary_output: separate path-class state/control delay or frozen bound; area and boundary quality accepted independently
S_model.target_scope: validate new common target/ABC/IO context; no automatic interpolation from old nine exact SDC points
S_model.sampling: finite owner/protocol/scale/target coverage; do not mechanically copy operator three-region grid

G_model.base_dependencies: freeze operator and S model/feature/domain/boundary bytes before residual extraction, fitting and independent evaluation
G_model.area_residual: measured stage combinational ownership area minus sum of unique frozen-model operator area predictions
G_model.delay_residual: measured combinational maximum for a declared path class minus frozen-model DAG longest-path baseline for that same class
G_model.explicit_wire_baseline: if independently qualified, include and subtract once; otherwise owned by residual
G_model.corrected_totals: finite nonnegative area/delay in qualified support; do not delete negative residuals to fit a positive-only algorithm
G_model.features: precomputable topology, operation counts/types, serial/parallel/reduction depth, width and bit mapping, fanout, connections, sharing/correlation structure, live-through/capture and target T
G_model.residual_scope: explicit path, path-class maximum or stage maximum; never broadcast a stage scalar as a per-node/per-path additive charge
G_model.data_sources: new synthetic stages and real consumer contexts; no full MAC evaluation PPA for fitting or tuning
G_model.validation: compare base and corrected errors/false feasibility/coverage; zero may qualify; new independent complete-stage test after freeze
G_model.model_change: recompute/revalidate on base or boundary changes; preserve old failed tests and their roles

joint_qualification.area: unique operator area + G residual + three S owner areas + separately qualified shared clock/physical/repair
joint_qualification.timing: actual DAG/path-class combinational prediction plus applicable state/boundary, IO and remaining frozen reserve, each once; slack is an observed comparison, not an additive delay
joint_qualification.test_policy: all clocks/stages/replicas of a complete source share one role; locked or consumed tests never fit or tune; new independent test only after all dependency freezes
